# Leonardo Castellano

> Portfolio of Leonardo Castellano, a cinematographer (director of photography) based in Milan, Italy. It shows his commercial and branded-content work for clients such as Vogue US, Vogue UK, Audemars Piguet, Campari, Alessi, KIA and Barilla, and his documentary, short-film and reportage work. He is available for commercial, film and documentary projects.

## Main pages
- [Commercial work](https://leonardocastellano.com/): Branded content and advertising, newest and most notable first.
- [Documentary](https://leonardocastellano.com/documentary/): Documentary, short film, editorial and reportage projects.
- [Contact](https://leonardocastellano.com/contact/): Email leonardocastellanodp@gmail.com and social profiles.
